race.description: Gundagai District Services Club Hair Of The Dog Cup (Bm66) Hcp
race.comment: SOUTHERN DANCER (1) has raced near the speed then battled on well to find minor placings at her two runs this prep, both in BM66 contests over 1600m at Albury. Last raced over 1800m in April and was beaten just two lengths in open company. Cherry ripe at the third run back and looks the testing material. SUPER PARADISE (3) has not looked like threatening in any of his four runs this time in work but the numbers say the performances measure up okay against this field. Tired at the end of 2000m at Albury last time so this slightly shorter trip should suit. DUNWITHYA (10) shouldered 61.5kgs in a BM50 over 1600m at Wagga recently and just prevailed. Takes on a better race today but drops a huge 6kgs which brings him right into contention. NATIONAL ASSET (9) is a consistent five-year-old who made up a stack of ground to finish second over 1460m at Queanbeyan last start. Has placed at this trip so one to keep safe. SORRY SUNSHINE (7) next best despite coming back sharply in trip.
